builds.name: Reference: Defensive attack weave
builds.goal: Reference for Camille: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A mobile duelist who times the second Q for enhanced true damage and isolates a chosen target with R. Short trading windows and wall angles matter more than blindly maximizing attack frequency. Time Q2 conversion and a single Spellblade item. Compare true-damage Q2 trades at matched gold; armor penetration does not multiply damage already converted to true damage. A single Spellblade plus conditional sustain tests repeated short melee trades.
builds.summary: A single Spellblade plus conditional sustain tests repeated short melee trades.
testPlan: Kit question for Camille: Time Q2 conversion and a single Spellblade item. Compare true-damage Q2 trades at matched gold; armor penetration does not multiply damage already converted to true damage.

Start with the early core (Trinity, then Sundered Sky or protection) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: A single Spellblade plus conditional sustain tests repeated short melee trades. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Camille's next attack deals bonus damage and grants bonus Move Speed. This spell can be recast for a short period of time, doing significantly increased bonus damage if Camille delays a period of time between the two attacks. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
